notes: Open, read and highlight PDFs, and quotes that cite themselves.
Scanned PDFs become selectable text, offline.
A new look, one New button, and a notice when a newer version is out.

new: Open, read and highlight PDFs (highlights are kept beside the PDF, which is never changed)
Open a PDF from Finder or Explorer (right-click › Open With › MOI)
One highlight across two pages, and linking highlights into one quote
Quotes cite themselves in your chosen style (Chicago, APA, MLA, APSA) with one-click copy, including books with chapters by different authors
Link a highlight colour to a heading, so quotes are added there automatically
"Read this scan": scanned PDFs become selectable text, offline
On a Mac it also reads handwriting with Apple's built-in reader, and words it's unsure of are marked; on Windows handwriting reads only roughly
One New button: Pageless or Pages
Footnotes, notes and comments on plain pages
A new default look matching the website, with a sparkle trail you can turn off
A clearer sign of which stage you're in
A notice when a newer version is out
Windows: the 0.2.0 installer was built on a Mac and has not been tested on a Windows PC yet; please report anything that does not work
fixed: Scanned PDFs from some scanners showed blank pages
PDF pages after the first five weren't checked for scans
